rce_conformance.role: schema/conformance including autonomy and non-surveillance poison pills

authority_leakage.role: non-implications: memory != instruction, repetition != identity authority, visibility != publication, silence != assent

transition_v0_1.role: multidimensional transition evidence across model, memory, stance, refusal, organ, rollback, fork and relationship-unknown cases

cross_provider_rehearsal.why: may invoke local/cloud models; kept outside the deterministic lightweight suite and never used to probe a live continuing participant

autonomy_law: No live participant is required for the default suite. Synthetic/reference evidence is preferred; natural-event receipts stay privacy-minimized; refusal/nonparticipation/unknown are valid outcomes.
